A clear canvas. A fresh start.

A place for every thought.

Camera: scroll to zoom. Hold the right mouse button and drag to pan. Scroll a stack’s top edge to flip notes.

Add: press N or double-click the canvas.

Edit: select a note and start typing. Use its top edge to drag it.

Stack: drop a note over another. Scroll over the top edge to flip through, or use the stack arrows. Click Separate on the stack to spread the notes apart.

Connect: choose Connect, then click two notes. Click a connection to remove it.

Sort: connect notes that share meaningful words. Choose an arrow or line first.

Notes save automatically in this browser on this device.
